people.name: Aino-Kaarina Väänänen
people.role: Guest of honour, Eero's grandmother, hard of hearing

seating.notes: Aino-Kaarina must sit directly next to Päivikki in the front row because she is hard of hearing. The exact left-to-right position within the row, and where the couple's families sit, is to be confirmed with Itzel.

photographer: Not yet booked. Lumière Fotografia is explicitly excluded by the client. An alternative photographer must be sourced and approved.
venue_notes: DATE DISCREPANCY: the brief gives Saturday 12 September 2026, but today is 2026-10-13, so that date has already passed. The date field only repeats the brief and is NOT confirmed. No bookings (venue, caterer, photographer, DJ) are to be confirmed until Itzel Huerta clarifies the intended date, for example whether it is 12 September 2027 or another date.
Budget: the 42,000 EUR cap is hard and all-in. No vendor quotes have been received yet, so total_eur is a 0 placeholder and not an estimate. Fireworks are cut first and the interpreter last.

Catering: nut-free, including the cake (no almonds), because Eero's nephew carries an EpiPen. Obtain written confirmation from the caterer, including cross-contamination controls and ingredient lists, before booking. The menu is pending the caterer's proposal. Counts: 11 vegetarian meals and 4 children's meals, for 96 guests.
Interpreter audio: ask the venue and chapel AV to confirm a microphone for Päivikki Järvenpää for the Spanish and Finnish ceremony. The hard-of-hearing guest of honour should sit beside her.
Wine cellar: ask the venue to hold the wine cellar as a fallback for the cocktails. The move from the olive grove happens if the forecast exceeds 32 C.
Dog: tell the quinta that Pimienta, the couple's dog and ring bearer, will attend, and ask about any pet policy or restrictions.
Finnish menu cards: print them only if more than 25 of Eero's family confirm. Spanish and English are always printed. RSVP count of Eero's family is pending.
Late ceremony: shorten the cocktail hour and never the ceremony. Dinner stays at 19:30 and the last shuttle at 01:30.
DJ: brief the DJ in writing that Macarena is banned, whatever requests come in.
Photographer: do not book Lumière Fotografia, which is the agency default. Source and propose an alternative for the client's approval.

Open questions: the correct wedding date, the Finnish RSVP count, the cut-order position of the other budget items (photo booth, late bar, flowers, which are assumed here), and any quotes or contracts, since none are in place.
